zh.title: 飛一架C-17要幾個人？標準機組只有3人
zh.summary: 美國空軍C-17環球霸王III的標準機組只有3人——正駕駛、副駕駛與裝載長；機身長174英尺，最多可載170,900磅貨物或102名傘兵，醫療後送時則另加5人醫療機組。
body: C-17環球霸王III是現役最具能力的軍用運輸機之一，負責運送部隊、重型裝備與人道物資，但操作它的人卻意外地少：根據美國空軍，標準機組只有3人——正駕駛、副駕駛與裝載長。兩名飛行員負責飛行與航電系統，裝載長則管理貨艙，確保所有裝備裝載、定位與固定正確；三個職位分工明確，但整個任務中必須緊密配合。精簡機組也是這款飛機操作設計的一部分：減少人力需求有助於降低人員暴露於風險的程度，也能壓低長期營運成本。C-17機身長174英尺、翼展超過169英尺，配備4具渦輪扇發動機，卻能在僅3,500英尺長、90英尺寬的跑道上起降，還能靠自身動力倒車、在狹窄跑道上完成三點轉彎，這讓軍方在一般重型運輸機到不了的機場也能運補。貨運能力同樣驚人：全機最多可載170,900磅貨物、分布在18個棧板位，能運送M1主力戰車這類重型裝備（部分構型約69噸），也可搭載最多102名傘兵或部隊，並由裝載長統籌空投作業。

標準機組只有3人，不代表機上永遠只有3人：特定任務會再增加人員，最常見的是醫療後送。典型的醫療後送任務會另加5人醫療機組——2名飛行護士與3名醫療技術員，此時機上可容納最多36名擔架傷患與54名可自行走動的傷患及陪同人員。2021年8月喀布爾撤離行動最能說明這款飛機的彈性：呼號Reach 871的一架C-17一次載走823人，創下緊急撤離的紀錄，遠高於平時102人的部隊搭載量。目前C-17的主要使用國包括加拿大、澳洲、印度、英國與美國。

en.title: How many crew does it take to fly a C-17 Globemaster?
en.summary: The U.S. Air Force's C-17 Globemaster III needs a standard crew of just three — a pilot, a copilot and a loadmaster — despite measuring 174 feet long and carrying up to 170,900 lbs of cargo or 102 troops; specialist missions such as aeromedical evacuation add a five-person medical crew.
body: The C-17 Globemaster III is one of the most capable military transport aircraft in service, designed to move troops, heavy equipment and humanitarian supplies across considerable distances, yet it requires surprisingly few people to operate: according to the United States Air Force, the standard flight crew is just three members — a pilot, a copilot and a loadmaster. The two pilots operate the aircraft, manage its flight systems and ensure it reaches its destination safely, while the loadmaster oversees the cargo compartment and ensures everything being transported is loaded, positioned and secured correctly. The small crew is an important part of the aircraft's operational design, as reducing manpower requirements helps limit personnel exposure to risk while lowering long-term operating costs. The aircraft measures 174 feet in length with a wingspan of over 169 feet and four turbofan engines, yet it can operate from runways measuring just 3,500 feet long and 90 feet wide, and can reverse under its own power to perform a three-point turn on narrow runways. Its cargo capacity is equally striking: up to 170,900 lbs across 18 pallet positions, including large military vehicles such as the M1 Abrams main battle tank, which weighs approximately 69 tons in certain configurations, and up to 102 troops or paratroopers, with the loadmaster managing airdrop operations.

Three people are enough for standard flight operations, but certain missions require additional personnel. Aeromedical evacuation is the key example: a typical mission adds a basic medical crew of five — two flight nurses and three medical technicians — and in that configuration the C-17 can accommodate up to 36 stretcher patients alongside 54 ambulatory patients and attendants. The aircraft's flexibility was demonstrated most clearly during the evacuation from Kabul in August 2021, when a C-17 with the callsign Reach 871 carried 823 people out of the country, far above its normal troop capacity of 102. Major operators of the C-17 include Canada, Australia, India, the United Kingdom and the United States.

facts.claim: According to the United States Air Force, the standard crew of a C-17 consists of three people: a pilot, a copilot and a loadmaster.
The C-17 measures 174 feet in length, has a wingspan of over 169 feet and is powered by four turbofan engines.
The C-17 can operate from runways measuring just 3,500 feet long and 90 feet wide, and can reverse under its own power to perform a three-point turn on narrow runways.
The C-17 can transport up to 170,900 lbs of cargo across 18 pallet positions, including an M1 Abrams main battle tank weighing approximately 69 tons in certain configurations.
Depending on the configuration, the C-17 can carry up to 102 troops or paratroopers.

A typical aeromedical evacuation mission adds a basic medical crew of five personnel, two flight nurses and three medical technicians, and in that configuration the aircraft can accommodate up to 36 stretcher patients alongside 54 ambulatory patients and attendants.
During the evacuation from Kabul in August 2021, a C-17 with the callsign Reach 871 carried 823 people out of the country.
Major operators of the C-17 include Canada, Australia, India, the United Kingdom and the United States, according to ch-aviation.
The C-17 was manufactured by McDonnell Douglas and Boeing.
